text.en:
Section 6 of Presidential Decree No. 129 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 6. Prohibitions. Except as may be authorized by the Monetary Board, no director or officer of an
Investment House shall concurrently be a director or officer of a bank, as defined in Section 2 of Republic Act
No. 337, as amended: Provided, however, That in no event can a person be authorized to be concurrently an
officer of an Investment House and of a bank except where the majority or all of the equity of the Investment
House is owned by the bank.
